description.value: BC Liquor Store at 28th & Main is one of 198 government-operated BCLIQUOR retail locations across British Columbia, selling wine, spirits, beer, ciders, coolers, and non-alcoholic products. The store is part of the provincial Liquor Distribution Branch and offers a broad selection with knowledgeable product consultants on staff. A touring cyclist could stop here to resupply on beverages, though it is a retail shop rather than a café or food-service venue.
